notes: CELOGToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named CHANGELOG.md (CELOG), with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It exposes an immutable on-chain CHANGELOG string, standard transfers and allowances, and no owner, administrator, further minting, burning, transfer fees or pause controls. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
